phrase.zh: 让不可见的世界，显露一角。
phrase.en: Let the unseen world reveal a little more.

visual.zh: 为伦琴独立创作的肖像拼贴，结合早期放电管与手部透视影像；是艺术解读，不是精确实验示意图。
visual.en: An original Röntgen portrait collage with an early discharge tube and hand radiograph; an artistic interpretation, not a precise experiment diagram.

background.zh:
威廉·康拉德·伦琴于1895年发现后来被称为X射线的射线，并获得1901年首届诺贝尔物理学奖。画面以早期放电管和手部骨骼影像，表现这项发现让人体内部结构能够被观察的意义。
1901年物理学奖；独享本年度奖项。获奖理由（中文译述）：表彰他发现后来以其名字命名的非凡射线所作出的卓越贡献。
background.en:
Wilhelm Conrad Röntgen discovered X-rays in 1895 and received the first Nobel Prize in Physics in 1901. An early discharge tube and a hand radiograph evoke the discovery that made internal structures visible.
1901 — The Nobel Prize in Physics. Received the full prize. Official motivation: in recognition of the extraordinary services he has rendered by the discovery of the remarkable rays subsequently named after him

labelLocalized.en: 1901 The Nobel Prize in Physics — official record
